notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
ULTIMAHJONG is no longer under active development.

UMJ was always a passion project for me and long story short, I've lost interest. I'm not giving up on the game completely, but development is at least going on hold for a while. Apologies to all those with high hopes for the game but I hope you at least enjoyed your time with the demo (which will remain available in its present state). In its stead I suggest you check out some similar games:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066570/Aotenjo_Infinite_Hands/  my closest 'competitor', not based on riichi but I played the demo a while ago and thought it was pretty fun

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870290/Omoikane/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507870/Mahjick__The_Realm_Taker/ this one's been out for a while actually

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809920/Drop_Mahjong_tiles/ haven't played but i followed the devlogs and it looks cute

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3488460/dirtbag_MAHJONG/ haven't played, been meaning to

Thank you to everyone who's contributed to the game and the community, all I ever wanted with UMJ was to push mahjong forward a little and while I had hoped for more I'm content with what I have. Forgive me for not talking much about development, I'm not as publicly oriented as I had hoped.

Soon:tm: I'll be releasing a free game over at https://nanahyakuman.itch.io/. It's a modern home-arcade style rhythm game—nothing like UMJ, I admit. If you're interested you can follow me there, although I'll probably make another announcement here.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
Just pushed a quick hotfix to the demo that should alleviate some of the windows crashes, although I won't gurantee it fixes all of them. It also adds localized winds, incidentially.

I'm going to have to look into this more in the future, but for now exporting the game in debug mode appears to have fixed a lot of the crashes I was getting on my laptop, and doesn't have much of an effect on gameplay. Literally speaking, the game is gonna theoretically run a little slower and be ~20mb larger but neither should really be noticable. 

Linux and macOS builds unaffected.

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Yahallo! A demo build for ULTIMAHJONG is out now! I'm hoping you enjoy the build, and I'm looking forward to your feedback. I will be as responsive as I can wherever capable, but for anonymous feedback and bug reporting, please see the forms below:

Feedback: forms.gle/MKQqbwEWAQV8YBUr6

Bug reporting: forms.gle/U9P2ZHiR5PwPYePx5


Enjoy the demo! There's no round limit or anything, so go wild with it. It's definitely a little light on items and so on right now, but I've found myself that there's still a lot of opportunity for creative plays to be made. Also, in the interest of transparency: I'll probably only leave the demo up for 2 or 3 weeks.
